summary: Uses one versioned review-autofix engine with reviewed automatic update PRs.

api.assessment: Removes copied autofix controllers, prompts and tests in favor of an immutable private shared-engine pin. Repository runner and SDK validation choices, feature-branch eligibility, bot-comment state, three-attempt budgets, opt-outs and fresh publication checks are preserved. Adds the caller-owned release-note engine and a read-only customer-impact gate for every PR, checking the authored feature and merged candidate against the PR base. Autofix requires explicit review of every current-PR record, stamps the staged source and independently validates again before publishing; historical records remain immutable. The engine includes bounded recovery for missing regression tests; it does not publish untested fixes. The base branch's runner DNS preservation, publisher credential preflight and inherited credential-helper cleanup remain implemented by the pinned engine, with their regression tests maintained centrally. Generated weekly update workflows open reviewable version PRs. Engine access uses a cleared checkout credential before PR dependencies or code execute; publication still runs on a separate fresh runner. No SDK signatures, requests, responses, authentication, runtime permissions, networking, retries, links, scopes, pagination, exports, downloads, storage policy, flags, supported Python versions, processing or rerun behavior, or infrastructure resources change.

rollout: The pinned engine activates for subsequent runs after this migration merges into the default branch. Existing terminal attempts and human pauses are not reset. Future automatic update PRs require a tested central release promoted to stable and normal consumer review. No application deployment, infrastructure apply or SDK package publication is performed by this change.
data_effect: Existing and newly processed results are unchanged. No customer data migration or processing rerun is required. Web, mobile web, embeds and native iOS behavior are unchanged; no TestFlight or App Store release is involved.
dependencies: Read access to the private KanopyAI/kanopy-autofix engine for the repository automation credential.
Engine-update publishing requires Contents, Pull requests and Workflows write access on the updater credential.

developer_notice.reason: Internal review automation consolidation with no customer-facing behavior change.
